json_ld.description:
The faster way to professional results at home. Like professional machines, the Bambino can deliver third-wave specialty coffee. This is made possible by the 4-key formula. Delivering barista quality performance using a 54mm portafilter with 18 grams of coffee for full flavor and a powerful steam wand to create microfoam required for latte art. With a proprietary ThermoJet heating system, the machine is ready to start in 3 seconds. 
Special Offer! Buy one Bambino and get the first order free on a Blend Box subscription using code: Probarista (must add both to cart)
